silos.name: Alloy & Engineering Steels
silos.intro: EN-series, SAE, DIN and tool steels in ready stock: EN8 to EN353, 42CrMo4, D2, D3, H13, DB6 and HSS, band-saw cut to your lengths with mill test certificates.

silos.name: Stainless Steel
silos.intro: Austenitic, martensitic and precipitation-hardening grades in bars, sheets, plates, pipes, hex and angles, from food-grade 304 to marine 316L and 17-4PH.

silos.name: Non-Ferrous Metals
silos.intro: Brass, electrolytic copper, gunmetal, phosphor bronze, aluminium bronze and aircraft-grade aluminium for bushes, busbars, valves and precision turned parts.

silos.name: Cast Iron
silos.intro: Continuous-cast grey and SG iron bars, solid and hollow, dense and free of blow holes, for hydraulic blocks, gears, pulleys and machine beds.

silos.name: Engineering Plastics
silos.intro: Nylon, cast nylon, Delrin, PTFE, UHMWPE, PP, Bakelite and acrylic in rods, sheets and blocks for wear pads, bushes, gaskets and insulation.

silos.name: Cutting & Workshop Tools
silos.intro: The consumables that keep a machine shop running: HSS and cobalt tool bits, bi-metal bandsaw blades, carbide inserts, end mills, taps, dies and chuck accessories.
